known_issues: PREVIEW firmware only: not stable, not recommended, not a customer default, not hardware verified, and not buyable.

These room-bundle fan artifacts share the `v1.0.0-preview` preview release with the room-bundle and LED preview artifacts. builds.description: Stable firmware for Sense360 Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ configuration. Recommended for production deployments.
features: PoE-powered Sense360 Core configuration
VentIQ bathroom air-quality sensing
RoomIQ room sensing
hardware_requirements: Sense360 Core (`S360-100`)
Sense360 VentIQ (`S360-211`)
Sense360 RoomIQ (`S360-200`)
Sense360 PoE PSU (`S360-410`)
known_issues: FanTRIAC is not included in this firmware. It is a separate compile-only / advanced-preview build (mains-voltage TRIAC dimming), not stable, and remains gated by COMPLIANCE-001 (mains-voltage electrical-safety review).
Sense360 LED is not included in this firmware: the selected configuration 'Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ' does not include LED. The LED-bearing sibling lives on the preview channel.
changelog: First stable release published through the automated build and publish pipeline - No functional firmware changes from 1.0.0

builds.description: Preview firmware for Sense360 Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ-LED configuration. Early-access build intended for limited validation of upcoming updates.
features: PoE-powered Sense360 Core configuration
VentIQ bathroom air-quality sensing
RoomIQ room sensing
Sense360 LED ring preview support
hardware_requirements: Sense360 Core R4 or newer
Sense360 PoE PSU
Sense360 VentIQ module
Sense360 RoomIQ module
Sense360 LED ring (S360-300)
known_issues: FanTRIAC is not included in this firmware and remains blocked pending HW-005.
This is a preview release. Do not treat it as the stable Release-One firmware.
LED bench-verification items remain open, including harness identity, LED count, and final install verification.
changelog: Added the first preview firmware build for `Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ-LED`.
This preview extends the Release-One ceiling PoE VentIQ + RoomIQ configuration with the Sense360 LED ring.
This is a preview-channel build for validation and testing. The stable Release-One firmware remains `Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ`.

features: rescue
